attributes.board_name: Maine State Board of Social Worker Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: In-person or virtual seminars, workshops, institutes, academic courses, in-service training (at least 15 h with immediate instructor interaction); max 10 h combined from non-interactive activities and teaching/writing/independent study
rules.audit_note: Attestation subject to audit under OPOR rules Chapter 13; keep documentation for the two most recent CE certifications.

topics.who: One-time 12 hours of coursework in family or intimate partner violence (required for renewal since Jan 1, 2020; counts toward CE)

rules.notes: Licenses expire biennially on December 31 or at other times designated by the Commissioner (32 M.R.S. §7060). CE in the preceding biennial license term.
